item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Vihaan lighting a piece of camphor on a plate. It burns with a steady flame. He then covers the camphor with a glass jar. After some time the flame goes out.

Which explanation is correct?

options.A: At first camphor as fuel, oxygen from the air, and heat above the camphor’s ignition temperature were all present; under the jar the oxygen ran low, so burning stopped.
options.B: The camphor caught fire as soon as it melted in air.
options.C: Once lit, the camphor needs only fuel to keep burning; heat above ignition temperature is not needed for continued burning.
options.D: The covered camphor keeps burning until the camphor runs out; oxygen is needed only to light it.
